name: livepremier-plus
description: The panels an Analog Way LivePremier or Midra 4K Web RCS is missing — an off-bus programmer, a VPU map, a command line, a cue stack, layer groups, matrix routing and an embedded Companion — served inside the vendor's own UI by a local proxy.
